description: Refused to answer the paper by leaving, this hour.
name: George Bryan

description: Wanted the doors open, accepted that there was no vote, and sent the room out.
name: James Burbage

description: Paid the ten, refused a new total, and set the roads at Monday.
name: John Heminges

description: Distinguished the share from her box, and refused to hear a plan.
name: Goodwife Margery Pell

description: Asked if the morning was another king, and was told it was a street.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Asked for the roads, and settled for Monday and his boots.
name: Will Kemp

description: Wrote the received line and left the balance blank.
name: William Shakespeare
